presets.label: Create the vertices table
sql: -- DuckDB: the workshop's SELECT … INTO plus its UPDATE that fills geom, osm_id, x and y,
-- written as one table built from the same data.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE vertices AS
SELECT id, in_edges, out_edges FROM pgr_extractVertices('SELECT id, source, target FROM ways ORDER BY id')
SELECT source AS vid, source_osm AS osm_id, ST_StartPoint(geom) AS pt FROM ways
SELECT target, target_osm, ST_EndPoint(geom) FROM ways
one_each AS (SELECT vid, any_value(osm_id) AS osm_id, any_value(pt) AS pt FROM get_data GROUP BY vid)
SELECT e.id, e.in_edges, e.out_edges, ST_X(o.pt) AS x, ST_Y(o.pt) AS y,
o.osm_id, NULL::BIGINT AS component, o.pt AS geom
FROM extracted AS e JOIN one_each AS o ON o.vid = e.id

presets.label: Connected components
sql: UPDATE vertices AS v SET component = c.component
FROM pgr_connectedComponents('SELECT id, source, target, cost, reverse_cost FROM ways')
ALTER TABLE ways ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS component BIGINT;
FROM (SELECT id, component FROM vertices) AS v
-- 51 components; the largest holds almost every way.
SELECT component, count(*) FROM ways GROUP BY component

presets.label: vehicle_net: roads for cars
sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vehicle_net AS
all_components AS (SELECT component, count(*) AS count FROM ways GROUP BY component),
max_component AS (SELECT max(count) AS max FROM all_components),
cost_s AS cost, reverse_cost_s AS reverse_cost,
name, length_m AS length, tag_id, geom AS geom
FROM ways AS w JOIN the_component USING (component) JOIN configuration USING (tag_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ways) AS ways, (SELECT count(*) FROM vehicle_net) AS vehicle_net;

presets.label: taxi_net: a smaller area, 10% dearer
sql: -- single-precision bounding boxes; comparing the bounds as FLOAT selects the same 2,887 ways.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW taxi_net AS
cost * 1.10 AS cost, reverse_cost * 1.10 AS reverse_cost,

presets.label: walk_net: paths for pedestrians
sql: -- DuckDB: a table where the workshop has a materialized view.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE walk_net AS
all_components AS (SELECT component, count(*) AS count FROM ways GROUP BY component),
max_component AS (SELECT max(count) AS max FROM all_components),
length_m / 2.0 AS cost, length_m / 2.0 AS reverse_cost,
FROM ways AS w JOIN the_component USING (component) JOIN configuration USING (tag_id)

presets.label: Costs only (pgr_dijkstraCost)
sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW pedestrian_cost_many_to_many AS
start_vid, end_vid, agg_cost, ST_MakeLine(v1.geom, v2.geom) AS geom
JOIN vertices AS v1 ON (start_vid = v1.id)
JOIN vertices AS v2 ON (end_vid = v2.id);

presets.label: One-way roads
sql: -- A negative cost closes that direction of a road.
(SELECT count(*) FROM vehicle_net WHERE cost < 0) AS closed_forward,
(SELECT count(*) FROM vehicle_net WHERE reverse_cost < 0) AS closed_backward;

presets.label: A penalty per road type (all 1.0)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vehicle_penalized_net AS
CASE WHEN cost <= 0 THEN -1 ELSE cost * penalty END AS cost,
CASE WHEN reverse_cost <= 0 THEN -1 ELSE reverse_cost * penalty END AS reverse_cost,

-- With every penalty 1.0 the route is the same as coming back.
SELECT seq, start_vid, end_vid, node, edge, cost, agg_cost, penalty
